subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Start from scratch

options.text: To start or create something from the very beginning
To develop something out of waste material

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To start or create something from the very beginning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Start from scratch"** means to begin something from the very beginning without any prior preparation or advantage. (शुरुआत से शुरू करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After losing all their data, they had to start the project from scratch.
 

 
• **"To start or create something from the very beginning"** means initiating a task or project without any existing foundation, starting anew. (शुरुआत से कुछ बनाना या शुरू करना)
 
 
• **Example:** When they moved to a new country, they had to build their lives from scratch.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To start or create something from the very beginning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To address an issue** (किसी मुद्दे को संबोधित करना): To deal with or discuss a problem or matter.
 
 
• **Example:** The manager called a meeting to address the issue of low productivity.
 
 
 
 
• **To develop something out of waste material** (कचरे से कुछ विकसित करना): To create or produce something useful from discarded or recycled materials.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist was known for developing beautiful sculptures out of waste material.
 
 
 
 
• **To point out something wrong** (कुछ गलत इंगित करना): To identify or highlight an error or mistake.
 
 
• **Example:** She was quick to point out the errors in the report.
